summary: Comprehensive test suite with two layers: unit tests covering manifest parsing (package.json and requirements.txt), license classification, report building, and formatting; end-to-end workflow tests executing through GitHub Actions via `act` with realistic scenarios (compliant and violations). All key requirements are exercised. Edge case coverage is strong for parsing and classification logic (malformed JSON, version normalization, case-insensitive matching, priority rules), but some gaps exist: CLI argument edge cases (missing values, malformed flags), special characters in package names (@org/scoped packages untested), and only two workflow scenarios. Excellent design with clear separation of concerns, proper test isolation using temp directories, helpful comments explaining the TDD approach, and realistic fixtures. Exact output matching strategy (not fuzzy assertions) and proper cleanup are strengths. Would reliably catch regressions in parsing, classification, formatting, and workflow integration, though some boundary conditions and scale scenarios lack verification.
